name: deepseek-flash-top3-notes
description: Same as deepseek-flash-top3, measured after the notes context change (2026-10-21): every note's path in the prompt, whole notes within 60,000 characters, the closest note as a hint, and a target note that may be any listed note or a proposed new one. The prompts differ, so it does not replay the top-3 cache.
